registryBasis: Adama City Administration’s official eLand identifies the Land Office and states digital land services for registration, transfer and information access. The city’s eService lists cadastral-map preparation, digital registration/mapping and parcel split/merge services. INSA reports a 2026 Adama Land Digital Transformation and Digital Address project designed with security-by-design. These sources establish a city land registry and digital workflows, but no anonymous public parcel-geometry endpoint.
